DIRECTION SETTLED (synckit lane source-read + user pre-authorization): (i) drop-EvalSymlinks is REFUSED by daemonkit by design — validateProgramTree (service/controller.go:470,493-524; keepalive.go:381-382) errors on any symlink component, and Homebrew exposes no non-symlink stable path; the anti-substitution guard stays. So the fix is (ii): a new exported daemonkit staging entry point — provisional `StableProgramFrom(name, source string) (string, error)`, DIGEST-keyed replacement (helpers carry no version; version.Newer gating doesn't fit) — now being implemented for a targeted v0.20.7 (user-authorized freeze exception, ship gated on review). synckit's canonicalHelperProgram then stages plain-executable helpers through it; EvalSymlinks survives as source resolution only.

SCOPE SPLIT: .app-bundled helpers (cookiesync — executable inside CookieSync.app/Contents/MacOS) must NOT be byte-staged out of their bundle (loses Info.plist/Resources/bundle identity → TCC/keychain/AssociatedBundleIdentifiers breakage); the right home is daemonkit's existing exported deployment package (NewCandidatePlan/ApplyInstalledCandidate, codesign-verified canonical install). Filed as a synckit follow-up; this task's criteria cover plain executables. Related new finding, filed separately in synckit: serviceAgents() runs only from install() — reconcile never re-derives helper programs, so stale paths persist until a manual synckitd install.
